scope: Prepare only missing source/reference/slot/final-decode requirements; no new media inventory, export or neural execution

workflow.meaning: Existing supplied workflow matches this example; does not authenticate actual user media/runtime revision.

existingProfilePolicy: Reuse accepted evidence in original scope. No re-export/re-inventory of these three diagnostic profiles. They do not accept actual workflow media by matching element count or aspect-ratio category.

roles.mediaSha256Reason: Actual workflow media bytes and decoded/orientation-corrected metadata are not available in the reviewed evidence. Filename/link is not a dimension or frame-supply proof.
roles.actualDecodedMetadataReason: Actual workflow media bytes and decoded/orientation-corrected metadata are not available in the reviewed evidence. Filename/link is not a dimension or frame-supply proof.
roles.processedRgbShapeReason: Requires actual frame supply and original node processing; workflow candidate F81 is conditional, not an observed shape.
roles.originalProcessing: source_video[:length] then area/center resize to workflow W/H. Do not add repetition/padding/frame reduction.

roles.mediaSha256Reason: No connected reference_video or supplied actual reference video in reviewed workflow.
roles.actualDecodedMetadataReason: Actual workflow media bytes and decoded/orientation-corrected metadata are not available in the reviewed evidence. Filename/link is not a dimension or frame-supply proof.
roles.processedRgbShapeReason: Actual reference F/H/W and original long-edge result required; not the source/output grid.
roles.originalProcessing: reference_video[:length] then original long-edge resize; no new padding/repetition.

roles.actualSlotBindingsReason: Need wired/editor selection, actual supplied file identity, slot order/mode and decoded image metadata per slot. Saved bypassed node links do not prove supply.
roles.actualDecodedMetadataReason: Actual workflow media bytes and decoded/orientation-corrected metadata are not available in the reviewed evidence. Filename/link is not a dimension or frame-supply proof.
roles.processedRgbShapeReason: F1 is known per image frame, but actual orientation-corrected H/W and original long-edge results are unknown.
roles.originalProcessing: wired input takes priority; fallback editor File; compact missing slots; encode each image-batch frame separately.

roles.actualGeneratedLatentReason: P5 actual producer/graph/precision and raw-restoration receipt do not yet exist for this required shape.
roles.producerModelSha256sReason: Must be provided by actual P5 generation; never substitute decoder VAE hash.
roles.rawRestoreNumericalReceiptReason: Required from Diffusion actual generated sample; mean normalization receipt and metadata alone cannot substitute.
roles.dependsOn: P5 actual producer and one Diffusion-owned raw restoration, matching VAE profile, independent reference/gate and resources

exporterConstraints.executionPrecision: Original BF16 values expanded to FP32; not GPU BF16/FP8 equivalence

missingProfilePreparationGates: Acquire actual media identity and decoded frame/timestamp/orientation/alpha metadata per role without substituting diagnostic media.
Apply only the original role-specific processing and record resulting exact F/H/W plus source/slot/frame/context association.
Determine whether an existing accepted exact profile covers the shape; only missing exact shapes enter a separate private export proposal.
Fix owner source/model, independent full-output reference, comparison gate and resource budget before any export/validation execution.
For each new profile record graph/assets/manifest shape and hashes, all-value FP32/browser comparison and lifecycle/resources separately.
Final generated decode additionally requires P5 producer hashes, normalized/raw before-after receipt and matching decoder.
newComparisonGateReason: New actual media/profile reference and numerical acceptance are not established. Do not borrow diagnostic2e-5, manifest.002 or mean2e-6 automatically.
prohibitedImplicitChanges: resize to fit an accepted diagnostic shape
